encoding.layout: C-order [layer][period][lat][lon]; layer 0 = slope, layer 1 = significant (1/0; 0 where slope is missing); period order = periods; rows north to south, columns west to east

rule: A cell needs at least 80% of the period's annual values (stored annual cell means, unquantized) to get a slope. The slope is the same OLS used for the global series (analytics.stats.ols_trend). significant = the AR(1)-adjusted 95% interval (effective sample size from the cell's residual lag-1 autocorrelation) excludes zero. Many cells are tested at once, so some significant cells are expected by chance; no multiple-testing correction is applied.
